text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I went outside the perimeter the other 
day, and had so much fun that I didn't 
want to go back...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... just thinking that no matter how far 
I go, there's always more scenery ahead...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I just can't stop. No matter what—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, I kinda get it. Going somewhere 
you've never seen before is pretty 
exciting, after all.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Still, sometimes taking a breather helps 
you go even farther in the long run.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
If you're planning on a long journey, it's 
best to rest somewhere along the way.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
And make the necessary preparations. So 
that I can walk forward again on strong 
legs.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
If we do that, we can go see the scenery 
as far ahead as we want. Right?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine. ...As long as you remember 
it from time to time.
